source.interpretation: Manual physical p336 says basic ONDEM TransportPolicyProfile.TPTIM overrides StationStructure.TFRMS, while TPTIMD may reference predefined <EXP>; when both are set, TPTIM is the distribution mean. The installed dictionary identifies TPTIM as hours and TPTIMD as the predefined <EXP> or a TimeDistributions.DISTID. This candidate keeps the link TFRMS=2 hours but sets policy TPTIM=3 in both arms, then adds <EXP> to the second arm only. One fixed-seed exponential draw can verify binding and event/report consistency but cannot establish a population mean or distribution shape.

predeclared_native_acceptance: Derive both arms only from the accepted E10.var01 ONDEM input. Change its ProblemDescription and TransportPolicyProfile.TPTIM 2 to 3; leave StationStructure.TFRMS=2, binding, stock, failure/repair, mission, seed, horizon, other policy fields and upstream transport unchanged. The arms differ only in ProblemDescription and TPTIMD null versus <EXP>.

The deterministic arm must show the same first failure near h9.8829, immediate h10 ONDEM spare dispatch, exactly three-hour physical downward transport, base arrival h13, local backorder wait three hours and subsequent aircraft readiness consistent with its unchanged 0.333333-hour fit. This distinguishes policy TPTIM=3 from link TFRMS=2 and the accepted parent's h12 arrival.

The exponential arm must import and calculate with zero converter errors, show one physical downward spare shipment with a positive, finite native logged transport-time realization distinct from 3 hours, and have arrival minus departure, local backorder wait and the corresponding report time series agree with that logged realization. The stored TPTIM=3 is a specified mean, not an expected exact single-draw time; no statistical mean or distribution-shape conclusion is permitted.

For both arms trace physical spare and failed-item identities, one local/depot demand, downward and unchanged upward transport, repair/restock, backorder, mission outcomes, 72 half-hour System/Stock report bins, terminal readiness/stock/backorder/in-transit and absence of authored resources. Explain any random-clock change in the exponential arm or classify the contrast NO-GO if the single-demand boundary is confounded.

Use fresh unique guarded session-0 SSH runs under Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue; preserve GUI PID13340; roundtrip every authored populated table; require converter Errors0, nonempty SXO/log/report, source and raw SHA-256 closure, and separate read-only independent replay without importing the author's checker.
limits: One fixed seed, one demand and one shared general downward link. A single <EXP> draw cannot validate its theoretical mean, variance or shape, and does not generalize to multiple queued requests, nested profiles, item-specific transport or other distributions.
GUI visual and cross-engine behavior remain unverified. Full E10, E11 and Issue #18 remain open.
